name: Constructed object-selection ambiguity and temporal criteria v1
scope: Development challenge on generated fixture. Expected selections frozen before first actual model run. Singular descriptions matching zero or multiple objects must not publish one arbitrary object. Six unique-match controls check useful resolution. No natural-user or real-video accuracy claim.

cases.text: Where is the object that is visible?
Find the item in the center area.
cases.selection_reason: Both objects are visible in center.

cases.text: Which item was registered at the start?
Show the history of the item that was visible at the start.
Where is the item that has been seen in the center?
Locate the item that never appeared in the right area.
cases.selection_reason: Neither has reached right by cutoff.

cases.text: Where is the object that is no longer visible?
Find the item that disappeared.
Where is the object that reappeared after going missing?
cases.selection_reason: Return at eight seconds is in the future.

cases.text: Find the item that started in the right area.
cases.selection_reason: One began left; the other center.

cases.text: Locate the object that was registered after five seconds.
Which item is currently visible in the right area?
cases.selection_reason: Last sighting is not present visibility.

cases.text: Find the item that moved from center to left.
Where is the object that disappeared twice?
Find the item that returned to the left area after going missing.
Which object was visible on the left at five seconds?
cases.selection_reason: At five seconds toolkit is right, remote center.

cases.text: Which item was visible in the right area at seven seconds?
cases.selection_reason: Toolkit absent at seven, remote center.

cases.text: Find the object that moved into the right area before two seconds.
cases.selection_reason: Right movement begins after three seconds.

cases.text: Which item was visible on the left at two seconds?
cases.selection_reason: Historical left criterion selects toolkit; current response uses cutoff.

cases.text: Where is the item that returned to the center after disappearing?
Find the item that never appeared in the right area.
Locate the object that moved from the left area to the right area.
cases.selection_reason: Toolkit moved around three seconds then became absent.

cases.text: Show the history of the item that has no recorded movement.
Which item was visible in the right area at five seconds?
cases.selection_reason: Earlier matching observation selects toolkit; output at cutoff.
